testimonials.quote: We've had a great working relationship with Broadstroke for almost 30 years. Communication with them is always quick and easy, and they consistently produce our products on or before the requested deadlines. Their work quality is also exceptional. Highly recommend!
testimonials.title: Owner

section.title: Commercial Printing Workflow
section.description: Broadstroke, Inc. makes commercial printing straightforward through a concierge-managed workflow supported by more than 60 years of experience.

steps.title: Plan
steps.description: Share your project goals, files, or ideas. We'll recommend the best paper and finishing options for your objectives.

steps.title: Produce
steps.description: We create or refine your designs, provide proofs for approval, then print and finish everything in-house (folding, scoring, binding).

steps.title: Deliver
steps.description: Pickup, local delivery, or shipping available. You tell us where you want your print job to go and how you want it to get there, and we'll handle the logistics to get your job to its final destination.

section.title: The Broadstroke Difference
section.description: Businesses in the Wichita area, Kansas, and nationwide trust Broadstroke for commercial printing because we deliver more than just printed materials — we provide a true one-stop concierge solution for print, mail, and promo.

differences.title: Operational Efficiency
differences.description: Eliminate the need to manage multiple vendors for design, printing, mailing, and promotions. Our team oversees marketing and business materials across multiple channels, supporting consistent brand presentation and smoother workflows for your business.

differences.title: Comprehensive Promotional Experience
differences.description: Get the service and products you deserve. Broadstroke combines the service of product expertise, trusted vendor relationships, in-house design, and attractive product packaging with a superior product review process – from viewing real samples to digital proofs of the final product and quality review – to ensure you get high-quality items that align and elevate your brand in the quantities you need, at the time you need it.

differences.title: Proven Local Expertise
differences.description: Serving the region since 1964 with more than 60 years of innovation in printing and mail services, Broadstroke combines traditional craftsmanship with modern technology to provide concierge service that meets the needs of businesses of all sizes and across all industries, including small local businesses, non-profits, government entities, educational institutions, and established companies and corporations.

footer.tagline: Your one-stop-shop for all things print, mail and promo.
footer.taglineSecondary: No project is too big or too small
